plugins.name: POCSAG, FLEX, DTMF and pager tones - multimon-ng companion
plugins.author: FoxSDR project
plugins.summary: Runs multimon-ng as a companion program next to FoxSDR and shows what it decodes: POCSAG, FLEX, DTMF and pager tones.
plugins.description: A companion plugin for multimon-ng. The decoder itself is a separate program; this small plugin starts it, feeds it the signal of the radio you give it, and shows what it decodes. This program cannot hide identifiers: whatever it decodes (callsigns, addresses, serial numbers, message text) is shown exactly as the program prints it. The program's source is published at https://github.com/wonderingStars/foxsdr-companions.
plugins.legalNotice: The companion program is separate software under its own licence (GPL-2.0-or-later) and is not included. Nothing here decodes encrypted traffic or transmits. Check what you may receive where you live.

companion.whySeparate: This is another person's open-source program, released under the GPL-2.0-or-later licence. That licence does not allow its code to be built into a closed-source program such as FoxSDR, so it stays an application of its own: FoxSDR starts it, hands it the signal and shows what it decodes.
